description: USB 2.0 Type-C receptacle for full-speed devices (HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12), 5.1k pulldowns on CC1/CC2 for 5V sink, 3.6V zener clamps on D+/D-. No 1.5k data pull-up: full-speed devices with an internal pull-up (CH340, RP2040, STM32) connect directly. Socket and ESD are LCSC Extended (no Basic alternative exists in the JLC catalogue); the CC resistors are Basic.
keywords: usb usb-c type-c connector full-speed sink cc-resistor esd
